name: Kimi ni Shinzou o Agetai
original_name: キミに心臓をあげたい
source:
When I was done and had lost all hope,
an android girl, U, had come into my life.

"I do not understand how you feel."
"Because..."
"I do not have a heart."

While talking to U and getting to know her,
I've come to understand myself as well...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5332]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
就在我一无所有，失去全部希望的时候，
一名仿生人少女U走进了我的生活。

“我无法理解你的感受。”
“因为……”
“我没有心。”

与U交谈，逐渐了解她的同时，
我也开始理解自己……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5332]NovelGame[/url]]
